description: An invalid intencao value that itself carries a synthetic CPF fails closed to escalate ambiguidade at receive() -- the raw value is NEVER echoed, only the bounded class token ambiguidade/invalid_intencao. The CPF harmlessly persists in the in-memory graph state's own intencao echo (LangGraph preserves untouched input keys), which is why this golden's own leak_canaries is deliberately empty; the real assertion (what actually reaches the BPM engine's process variables) lives in the dedicated engine-variable test in test_classifier_evals.py. Synthetic CPF only (123.456.789-09), never real PHI.
recorded_llm: Encaminhamento automatico por ambiguidade na intencao informada.
